messages:
Raj: quick heads-up  I'm proposing a backward-compatible migration for preview flags. goal: unify beta_preview + preview_cohort into one scoped object.
Elena: 👍 can you outline compatibility rules? we still have mobile teams hitting old schema.
Raj: plan: API layer will accept old keys and respond with a preview_meta wrapper. server will write normalized records but keep raw payload in audit logs.
Marco: important: scope semantics change. old flags were org-scoped, new previews should support route+env scoping. need a clear merge strategy.
Raj: merge strategy: keep existing org-scoped as-is but add a scoped_preview field when route-level overrides exist. server chooses most-specific (route > env > org).
Elena: console UX ask: when both org and route previews exist, show a concise precedence line and a small diff view. users should be able to expand to see the full configs.
UX-Kit: mock uploaded: https://redwood.design/preview-migration-diff. shows precedence chip + inline rollback per-scope.
Marco: telemetry gating: emit preview.scope_effective and preview.conflict(boolean). that'll help detect unintended overlaps.
Raj: also adding an etag to preview config responses so clients can do optimistic updates. header: ETag: "pv-<hash>"
Elena: great. what's retention for the raw legacy payloads? we shouldn't keep them forever.
Raj: retention policy: raw payloads kept 30d, normalized history 365d. ops can request extended retention per-customer.
ops-bot: scheduled migration dry-run on staging (job: mig-1757012345). streaming preview.* metrics to staging telemetry.
Marco: migration idempotency check? make sure replays don't create duplicate cohort assignments.
Raj: migration will be idempotent by using deterministic cohort ids derived from customer+hash of payload. avoids duplicates.
Elena: rollout plan? feature-flag the console change and flip API compatibility after 2 weeks of telemetry monitoring.
Raj: yep. feature flagging + gradual traffic lift. I'll open PR with tests + migration tool. tagging @Elena @Marco.
ops-bot: dry-run complete. no conflicts detected. preview.conflict=0. next: enable console mock behind flag.
Marco: will coordinate release window. thanks team. :shipit:
